abilities.desc_zh: 攻击附带高压电离冲击，命中时降低对手能量获取率 35%，并有几率对格斗系敌人的霸体状态造成直接电击打断。
abilities.desc_en: Attacks carry high-voltage ionization, reducing opponent Power Flow by 35% and interrupting Brawler Unstoppable states.

abilities.desc_zh: 离子风在场时，敌人无法触发任何不可阻挡 (Unstoppable) 或暴怒增益，近战接触时反噬强力电击。
abilities.desc_en: Suppresses enemy Unstoppable and Fury buffs; enemies take electric shocks when attempting melee rushes.

abilities.desc_zh: 敌方释放特殊技时，离子风有 75% 几率引爆其电磁核心，直接吸收其 50% 能量并使其眩晕 2 秒。
abilities.desc_en: When opponent fires a Special Attack, Ion Storm has a 75% chance to overload their core, absorbing 50% of the energy and stunning them for 2s.

abilities.desc_zh: 轰出高压电磁脉冲，直接打掉对手 {{var_1}} 能量槽，并造成触电在 {{var_2}} 秒内造成 {{var_3}} 伤害。
abilities.desc_en: Blasts an EMP wave, draining {{var_1}} Power and inflicting Shock dealing {{var_3}} damage over {{var_2}} seconds.

abilities.desc_zh: 召唤连锁电弧轰击敌人，造成强力触电在 {{var_4}} 秒内造成 {{var_5}} 伤害，并眩晕对手 {{var_6}} 秒。
abilities.desc_en: Strikes with cascading lightning, inflicting Shock dealing {{var_5}} over {{var_4}}s and stunning for {{var_6}}s.

abilities.desc_zh: 急速盘旋制造雷暴龙卷，彻底电离敌方电路，削减对手 {{var_7}} 能量获取速率持续 {{var_8}} 秒。
abilities.desc_en: Creates a lightning cyclone, ionizing circuits and reducing enemy Power Flow by {{var_7}} for {{var_8}} seconds.

abilities.desc_zh: 与酸雨、新星风同队时，全队元素减益持续时间延长 {{var_1}}。
abilities.desc_en: Elemental debuffs last {{var_1}} longer when teamed with Acid Storm and Nova Storm.

abilities.desc_zh: 与红蜘蛛同队时，获得 +{{var_2}} 能量获取速率。
abilities.desc_en: +{{var_2}} Power Rate when paired with Starscream.

abilities.desc_zh: 团队所有低星级队员获得 +{{var_3}} 电击伤害。
abilities.desc_en: All lower tier teammates gain +{{var_3}} Shock Damage.
